# A Constitution That Can Change

<!-- STEP id="dynamic-not-rigid" -->
## Not a Rigid Code

The members of the Assembly believed that a constitution should not be a rigid legal code. It should be a dynamic document, able to change through lawful amendments without harming its fundamental values. An amendment is a formal change to the text.

<!-- STEP id="article-368" -->
## Article 368

**Article 368** provides for amendments, so the Constitution can respond to new needs. Press **Add an amendment**: the four values, liberty, equality, justice and fraternity, stay.

**So was ancient India already democratic? Not fully, but its habit of consultation has deep roots.**
